title: Platform overview
content:
# Platform overview

The PowerEdge XR5610 is a short-depth, single-socket 1U server designed for edge and telecom sites, where racks are shallow and conditions are harsher than in a data centre. It is managed out-of-band with **iDRAC9**.

## Why we chose it

- **Short depth** fits the shallow cabinets at our sites.
- **Rugged design** for sites with dust, vibration and wide temperature swings.
- **Single socket** keeps power and cost down for modest edge workloads.
- **iDRAC9** gives remote console, power control and alerts when nobody is on site.

## Our standard build

These are the values on our purchase order, not limits of the platform.

| Component | Our build |
| --- | --- |
| Processor | 1 × Intel Xeon (4th generation Scalable family), 24 cores |
| Memory | 256 GB (8 × 32 GB) |
| Boot | 2 × M.2 SSD, mirrored |
| Data | 4 × 1.92 TB SSD |
| Network | 2 × 25 GbE for workloads, 1 GbE dedicated iDRAC port |
| Power | 2 redundant supplies; AC or DC to match the site |

Installed units are listed in [[Server inventory]]. Setup starts with [[iDRAC9 setup]].
